correctness.rationale: For each realized retained subset, independent conditional bridge segments imply exact integrated posterior variance sum gap^2/6. Summation gives a quadratic with positive definite Hessian since the all-retained event has probability p^n>0. Conditional left/right gap expectations at the prescribed candidate both equal 1/[2+(n-1)p], so the interior gradient vanishes. Strict convexity proves global uniqueness including endpoints/coincidences, and a telescoping identity gives the exact sharp minimum. The standalone checker produced 405 exact rational assertions; these supplement, not replace, the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Independent packet erasures change which node positions minimize whole-trajectory mean-square reconstruction; the resulting design differs from the two established alternatives of uniform noiseless sampling and single-integral quadrature. This fully finite-budget solution identifies an exact optimal geometric deployment for every n and p, an exact attainable path risk, and a clear spatial transition from uniform spacing to clustered midpoint sampling. A full-path precision objective is natural for Gaussian-process interpolation and does not require an invented downstream application.
